segments.text:
How notoriously false and absurdis that doctrin which asserteth the possibility of believing without the efficacy of supernatural grace?
The desire of self-sufficiency was the ruin of Adam, and the conceit of self-sufficiency is the ruin of multitudes of his posterity. This doctrine is not only contradictory to the current stream of Scripture, Phil. 2. 13. 1 Joh. 1. 13. with many other Scriptures: but it is also contradictory to the common sense and experience of believers: yet the pride of nature will strive to maintain, what Scripture and experience plainly contradict and overthrow.
